evidence.why: The vendored underscore.js is never loaded with its own global binding anywhere that would exercise throttle: perf/perf.js loads this exact file as `_` but its hardcoded suites never call `.throttle`; test/underscore.html dynamically injects vendor/underscore/test/functions.js (which does call `_.throttle(...)` and invoke the returned closure as `throttledIncr`) but that harness sets `_` to `../lodash.js`, not this vendor file, so the call resolves to lodash's own throttle, not this closure; and the apparent `throttled()` call sites in test/test.js are lodash's own `_.throttle` test (a same-named but unrelated local variable) and that file is explicitly excluded from this project's indexed corpus. No code path in the repo actually invokes `_.throttle` on this vendored underscore object, so the inner `throttled` closure is genuinely unreachable.
